literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi: Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu
idiomatic: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi — Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu

literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV
idiomatic: Emperor Tianzuo IV

literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on xinsi day, Xiang Xiaohulu sent men asking the emperor to visit his territory.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on xinsi day of the first spring month, Xiang Xiaohulu sent envoys asking the emperor to visit his territory.

literal: On wuzi day he hastened to Tiande; crossing the desert, Jin troops suddenly arrived.
idiomatic: On wuzi day he hastened toward Tiande; crossing the desert, Jin troops suddenly appeared.

literal: The emperor fled on foot; attendants offered a pearl cap; he refused it, mounted Zhang Rengui's horse and escaped, and reached Tiande.
idiomatic: The emperor fled on foot; attendants offered a pearl cap, but he refused it, mounted Zhang Rengui's horse, and escaped to Tiande.

literal: [1] On jichou day he met snow and had no cold-weather gear; diviners presented sable-fur caps;
idiomatic: [1] On jichou day he met snow and had no cold-weather gear; diviners presented sable-fur caps;

literal: on the road food ran out; diviners presented bu and jujubes;
idiomatic: on the road food ran out; diviners presented bu and jujubes;

literal: when he wished to rest, the diviners at once knelt and sat, leaning against them for a brief sleep.
idiomatic: when he wished to rest, the diviners at once knelt and sat so he could lean on them for a brief sleep.

literal: The diviners could only gnaw ice and snow to stave off hunger.
idiomatic: The diviners could only gnaw ice and snow to stave off hunger.

literal: He passed Tiande.
idiomatic: He passed Tiande.

literal: At night, about to lodge in a commoner's house, he deceived them saying scouting horsemen; the household knew and thereupon knocked the horse's head, knelt and wept greatly, and he lodged secretly in their house.
idiomatic: At night, about to lodge in a commoner's house, he deceived them by saying scouting horsemen were about; the household knew who he was, knocked the horse's head, knelt and wept greatly, and he lodged secretly in their home.

literal: After several days he praised their loyalty and from afar invested them as military commissioner, then hastened to Xiang.
idiomatic: After several days he praised their loyalty and from afar invested them as military commissioner, then hastened to Xiang.

literal: He made Xiaohulu southwestern frontier commissioner for suppression, overall commander of military affairs, and still granted his son and various officers titles and rewards in differing degrees.
idiomatic: He made Xiaohulu southwestern frontier commissioner for suppression and overall commander of military affairs, and still granted his son and various officers titles and rewards in differing degrees.

literal: Second month, sixty li east of Ying Prefecture's new city, he was captured by Jin men Wanyan Lou Shi and others.
idiomatic: In the second month, sixty li east of Ying Prefecture's new city, he was captured by the Jin commander Wanyan Lou Shi and others.

literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, he reached Jin.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao day, he reached Jin territory.

literal: On bingwu day he was demoted and enfeoffed Prince of the Sea Shore.
idiomatic: On bingwu day he was demoted and enfeoffed as Prince of the Sea Shore.

literal: He died of illness, age fifty-four, on the throne twenty-four years.
idiomatic: He died of illness at fifty-four, having reigned twenty-four years.

literal: Jin Huangtong year 1, second month, he was changed to Prince of Yu.
idiomatic: In the second month of Jin Huangtong year 1 he was changed to Prince of Yu.

literal: Year 5, buried beside Qian Mausoleum in Guangning Prefecture, Lüyang County.
idiomatic: In year 5 he was buried beside Qian Mausoleum in Lüyang County, Guangning Prefecture.

literal: Yelü Chun
idiomatic: Yelü Chun

literal: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.
idiomatic: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.

literal: Chun's childhood name was Nieli; he was Emperor Xingzong's fourth-generation grandson, son of Southern Capital regent and Song Prince of Wei Heluwo.
idiomatic: Chun's childhood name was Nieli; he was Emperor Xingzong's fourth-generation grandson, son of Southern Capital regent and Song Prince of Wei Heluwo.

literal: In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised and nurtured him.
idiomatic: In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised and nurtured him.

literal: [2] When grown he was devoted to literature.
idiomatic: [2] When grown he was devoted to literature.

literal: When the Memorializing Heir Apparent was condemned, the emperor wished to make Chun heir.
idiomatic: When the Memorializing Heir Apparent was condemned, the emperor wished to make Chun heir.

literal: The emperor was angry at Yelü Baisi, knowing he was friendly with Chun, and sent Chun out as Zhangsheng and other armies military commissioner.
idiomatic: The emperor was angry at Yelü Baisi, knowing he was friendly with Chun, and sent Chun out as Zhangsheng and other armies military commissioner.

literal: Tianqing year 5, on the eastern campaign, superintendent Zhangnu crossed the Yazi River; with Chun's son Asa and more than three hundred others he fled back, first sending Dili and others to report Chun the plan to depose and enthrone; Chun beheaded Dili's head and presented it, was advanced Prince of Qin-Jin, appointed commander-in-chief, granted the gold warrant, exempted from Han bowing ritual, not called by name.
idiomatic: In Tianqing year 5, on the eastern campaign, superintendent Zhangnu crossed the Yazi River; with Chun's son Asa and more than three hundred others he fled back, first sending Dili and others to report to Chun the plan to depose and enthrone; Chun beheaded Dili and presented his head, was advanced Prince of Qin-Jin, appointed commander-in-chief, granted the gold warrant, exempted from Han bowing ritual, and not called by name.

literal: Permitted to choose his own officers and soldiers, he thereupon recruited elite troops of Yan and Yun.
idiomatic: Permitted to choose his own officers and soldiers, he thereupon recruited elite troops of Yan and Yun.

literal: Going east to Jinzhou, company chief Wu Chaoyan made disorder and seized Chun.
idiomatic: Going east to Jinzhou, company chief Wu Chaoyan made disorder and seized Chun.

literal: Chun hid and escaped, gathered Chaoyan and executed him.
idiomatic: Chun hid and escaped, gathered Chaoyan and executed him.

literal: When Jin troops arrived he gathered troops and fought at Ali Zhendou, was defeated, gathered scattered soldiers of several thousand and resisted them.
idiomatic: When Jin troops arrived he gathered troops and fought at Ali Zhendou, was defeated, gathered several thousand scattered soldiers and resisted them.

literal: Chun entered court; his crime was pardoned; an edict ordered Nanjing to carve stone recording his merit.
idiomatic: Chun entered court; his crime was pardoned; an edict ordered Nanjing to carve stone recording his merit.

literal: Yelü Yali
idiomatic: Yelü Yali

literal: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.
idiomatic: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.

literal: At age seven he wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
idiomatic: At age seven the court wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.

literal: Baoda year 3, Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.
idiomatic: In Baoda year 3 Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.

literal: Grand Protector Temuge seized him and fled; by hidden route they reached Yin Mountain.
idiomatic: Grand Protector Temuge seized him and fled; by a hidden route they reached Yin Mountain.

literal: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.
idiomatic: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.

literal: At the time those in attendance were more than a thousand, more than Tianzuo had.
idiomatic: At the time those in attendance were more than a thousand — more than Tianzuo had.

literal: Tianzuo feared Temuge would cause trouble and wished to execute him.
idiomatic: Tianzuo feared Temuge would cause trouble and wished to execute him.

literal: He blamed him for being unable to fully save the princes and was about to interrogate him.
idiomatic: He blamed him for being unable to fully save the princes and was about to interrogate him.

literal: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?
idiomatic: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?

literal: " Yali replied, "Nothing else was said.
idiomatic: " Yali replied, "Nothing else was said.

literal: " He then released him.
idiomatic: " He then released him.

literal: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.
idiomatic: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.

literal: Reaching Sha Ridge they saw a snake cross the road; those who knew omens deemed it inauspicious.
idiomatic: Reaching Sha Ridge they saw a snake cross the road; those who knew omens deemed it inauspicious.

literal: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.
idiomatic: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.

literal: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.
idiomatic: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.

literal: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.
idiomatic: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.

literal: Those captured who had fled were only flogged.
idiomatic: Those captured who had fled were only flogged.

literal: Those who returned of themselves were at once given office.
idiomatic: Those who returned of themselves were at once given office.

literal: He thereupon said to those at his side, "If you wish to attach, come and attach;
idiomatic: He thereupon said to those at his side, "If you wish to attach, come and attach;

literal: if you do not attach, then go.
idiomatic: if you do not attach, then go.

literal: Why must there be coercion?"
idiomatic: Why must there be coercion?"

literal: Each time he took Tang's Zhenguan zhengyao and Linya Zizhong's poem on governing the state and ordered attendants to read them.
idiomatic: Each time he took Tang's Zhenguan zhengyao and Linya Zizhong's poem on governing the state and ordered attendants to read them.

literal: Ugu Route military commissioner Jiuzhe, Dilie Tribe commander-in-chief Tabuye, and superintendent Tulideng each led their masses to come and attach.
idiomatic: Ugu Route military commissioner Jiuzhe, Dilie Tribe commander-in-chief Tabuye, and superintendent Tulideng each led their masses to come and attach.

literal: From this time the various tribes came in succession.
idiomatic: From this time the various tribes came in succession.

literal: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.
idiomatic: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.

literal: Temuge urgently remonstrated; he then no longer went out.
idiomatic: Temuge urgently remonstrated; he then no longer went out.

literal: He made Yelü Dilie privy commissioner; Temuge was his deputy.
idiomatic: He made Yelü Dilie privy commissioner; Temuge was his deputy.

literal: Dilie impeached Northwestern Route commissioner for suppression Xiao Jiuli for deluding the masses, his intent not that of a subject, and together with his son Manei executed them.
idiomatic: Dilie impeached Northwestern Route commissioner for suppression Xiao Jiuli for deluding the masses, his intent not that of a subject, and together with his son Manei executed them.

literal: He made Yaoshe commissioner for suppression; fighting with the various tribes, several times defeated, was flogged and dismissed from office.
idiomatic: He made Yaoshe commissioner for suppression; fighting with the various tribes, several times defeated, was flogged and dismissed from office.

literal: Among those following, if any were weary, he would at once give relief.
idiomatic: Among those following, if any were weary, he would at once give relief.

literal: Direct attendant Baode remonstrated, saying, "Now the state is empty; if bestowals are like this, how will we supply them?
idiomatic: Direct attendant Baode remonstrated, saying, "Now the state is empty; if bestowals are like this, how will we supply them?

literal: " Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.
idiomatic: " Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.

literal: Without the various tribes, what would I take?
idiomatic: Without the various tribes, what would I take?

literal: " He did not accept it.
idiomatic: " He did not accept it.

literal: Earlier he had ordered the herd offices to transport Salt Marsh granary grain, but the people stole it; discussion was to register them to compensate.
idiomatic: Earlier he had ordered the herd offices to transport Salt Marsh granary grain, but the people stole it; discussion was to register them to compensate.

literal: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;
idiomatic: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;

literal: three carts, one ox;
idiomatic: three carts, one ox;

literal: five carts, one horse;
idiomatic: five carts, one horse;

literal: eight carts, one camel.
idiomatic: eight carts, one camel.

literal: Those at his side said, "Now one sheep cannot even be exchanged for two dou of grain, yet you compensate one cart!
idiomatic: Those at his side said, "Now one sheep cannot even be exchanged for two dou of grain, yet you compensate one cart!

literal: " Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.
idiomatic: " Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.

literal: If you make them compensate in full, how can the people bear it?"
idiomatic: If you make them compensate in full, how can the people bear it?"

literal: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died, age thirty.
idiomatic: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died at thirty.

literal: Yelü Dashi
idiomatic: Yelü Dashi

literal: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao.
idiomatic: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).

literal: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.
idiomatic: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.

literal: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.
idiomatic: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.

literal: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.
idiomatic: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.

literal: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

literal: Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.
idiomatic: In Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.

literal: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.
idiomatic: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.

literal: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.
idiomatic: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.

literal: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?
idiomatic: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?

literal: " He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.
idiomatic: " He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.

literal: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?
idiomatic: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?

literal: " The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.
idiomatic: " The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.

literal: Dashi was ill at ease; he thereupon killed Xiao Yixue and Poliguo, styled himself king, and led two hundred iron cavalry fleeing by night.
idiomatic: Dashi was ill at ease; he thereupon killed Xiao Yixue and Poliguo, styled himself king, and led two hundred iron cavalry fleeing by night.

literal: Going north three days, crossing Black Water, he met Baidada xiangwen Chuangur.
idiomatic: Going north three days, crossing Black Water, he met Baidada xiangwen Chuangur.

literal: Chuangur presented four hundred horses, twenty camels, and sheep in number.
idiomatic: Chuangur presented four hundred horses, twenty camels, and sheep in number.

literal: Going west to Kedun city, he encamped at the Protectorate of the Pacified North, meeting the seven prefectures Weiwu, Chongde, Huifan, Xin, Dalin, Zihe, Tuo and the eighteen tribal kings of Great Yellow Shivewei, Dila, Wangjila, Chachila, Yexi, Bigude, Nila, Dalaguai, Damili, Mierji, Hezhu, Wuguli, Zubu, Pusuwan, Tanggu, Humusi, Xide, and Jiuerbi, [6] and addressed them, saying, "Our ancestors with hardship founded the enterprise; through the ages nine lords; through the years two hundred.
idiomatic: Going west to Kedun city, he encamped at the Protectorate of the Pacified North, meeting the seven prefectures Weiwu, Chongde, Huifan, Xin, Dalin, Zihe, Tuo and the eighteen tribal kings of Great Yellow Shivewei, Dila, Wangjila, Chachila, Yexi, Bigude, Nila, Dalaguai, Damili, Mierji, Hezhu, Wuguli, Zubu, Pusuwan, Tanggu, Humusi, Xide, and Jiuerbi, [6] and addressed them, saying, "Our ancestors with hardship founded the enterprise; through the ages nine lords; through the years two hundred.

literal: Jin as subject-state forced our state, ravaged our black-haired people, slaughtered and mowed our prefectures and counties, making our Emperor Tianzuo suffer dust abroad — day and night we are heartsick.
idiomatic: Jin as subject-state forced our state, ravaged our black-haired people, slaughtered and mowed our prefectures and counties, making our Emperor Tianzuo suffer dust abroad — day and night we are heartsick.

literal: I now take righteousness and go west, wishing to borrow the strength of the various fan, cut down our foe, and recover our territory.
idiomatic: I now take righteousness and go west, wishing to borrow the strength of the various fan, cut down our foe, and recover our territory.

literal: Do only you masses also grieve for our state, worry for our altars, and think to together save the lord and father and rescue the black-haired people from hardship?"
idiomatic: Do only you masses also grieve for our state, worry for our altars, and think to together save the lord and father and rescue the black-haired people from hardship?"

literal: He thereupon obtained elite troops of more than ten thousand, set officials, established ranks, and prepared weapons.
idiomatic: He thereupon obtained elite troops of more than ten thousand, set officials, established ranks, and prepared weapons.

literal: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.
idiomatic: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.

literal: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;
idiomatic: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;

literal: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.
idiomatic: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.
